enum.name: MODE_CODE
enum.description: ACFly flight state code. Values map one-to-one to the mode_code property of the DJI Cloud API (dock-to-cloud MQTT aircraft properties).

entry.name: MODE_CODE_TAKEOFF_READY
entry.description: Takeoff preparation complete, ready to take off.

enum.name: MODE_CODE_REASON
enum.description: Reason for the vehicle entering the current flight state. Values below 100 map one-to-one to the mode_code_reason property of the DJI Cloud API. Values 100 and above are ACFly vendor-specific extension reasons.

entry.name: MODE_CODE_REASON_RC_BUTTON
entry.description: Requested by remote controller button (takeoff, RTH, landing).

entry.name: MODE_CODE_REASON_RC_LOST
entry.description: Remote control signal lost (RTH, landing, hover).

entry.name: MODE_CODE_REASON_EXTERNAL
entry.description: Triggered by external device (dock, swarm, etc.).

entry.name: MODE_CODE_REASON_MISSION_TAKEOFF
entry.description: Requested while executing a waypoint mission (takeoff).

entry.name: MODE_CODE_REASON_RTL_HOME_LAND
entry.description: RTH phase reached overhead of the home point, landing requested (landing).

entry.name: MODE_CODE_REASON_LVOLT_RTL_LAND
entry.description: Entering landing after smart low-battery RTH (landing).

entry.name: MODE_CODE_REASON_ATTITUDE_NOT_READY
entry.description: Attitude estimation system not yet initialized (standby).

entry.name: MODE_CODE_REASON_ALTITUDE_NOT_READY
entry.description: Altitude estimation system not yet initialized (standby).

entry.name: MODE_CODE_REASON_NO_POSITION
entry.description: Position estimation not initialized: no positioning or positioning accuracy insufficient (standby, takeoff preparing).

entry.name: MODE_CODE_REASON_GPS_NOT_FIXED
entry.description: GNSS positioning not yet at fixed solution (takeoff preparing).

entry.name: MODE_CODE_REASON_DAO_NOT_FIXED
entry.description: Direction-finding (DAO) not yet at fixed solution (takeoff preparing).

entry.name: MODE_CODE_REASON_RC_TAKEOVER
entry.description: User moved the sticks and took over control, interrupting the automatic task or landing (manual flight).

entry.name: MODE_CODE_REASON_MISSION_NAV
entry.description: Automatic RTH or landing waypoint within the wayline mission (RTH, landing).

entry.name: MAV_CMD_SET_ACFLY_FUNCTION
entry.description: Enable or disable ACFly functions. The function is selected by param1, and param2 (and param3 for trajectory replay) carry the function specific setting: 100: headless mode switch. 101: obstacle avoidance switch. 102: terrain following switch. 103: follow mode switch. 112: trajectory record switch, param2 greater than 0 enables recording with the trajectory index, 0 stops recording. 113: trajectory replay switch, param1 is the trajectory index, greater than 0 starts replay, 0 stops replay.
entry.param: Function selector: 100 headless mode, 101 obstacle avoidance, 102 terrain following, 103 swarmFollow mode, 112 trajectory replay record, 113 trajectory replay start.

Function setting. For functions 100/101/102/103: 1 enable, 0 disable. For function 112: trajectory index to record, 0 stops recording. For function 113: replay start mode (0 replay from recorded start point, 1 replay from current point, 2 slowly converge to the recorded trajectory, 3 replay from current point and heading). Unused for other values.
For function 113 only: 0 forward replay, 1 reverse replay, 2 reverse replay with unchanged yaw. Unused otherwise.

entry.name: MAV_CMD_START_CIRCLE
entry.description: Start flying a circle. The circle center is given by param5/param6/param7. Positive param1 flies clockwise, negative counterclockwise. param3 controls the vehicle heading reference during the circle: values in [-360, 360] are relative to the circle frame with origin at the circle center, where 0 points toward the center and 90 points along the circle tangent; values in [-1360, 1360] with a 1000 offset are absolute fixed angles in the North-East-Down frame, where 1000 points north, 1090 points east, -1090 points west, and 1180/-1180 point south.
entry.param: Circle speed. Greater than 0 flies clockwise, less than 0 flies counterclockwise.

Heading during the circle. In [-360, 360]: relative to the circle frame centered on the circle center, 0 points to the center, 90 points along the tangent. In [-1360, 1360] with 1000 offset: fixed absolute angle in the North-East-Down frame, 1000 north, 1090 east, -1090 west, 1180/-1180 south.
Circle center altitude relative to home.

entry.name: MAV_CMD_AIRPORT
entry.description: Control the airport (drone dock/nest): open/stow it, power the aircraft on/off, replace or charge the battery, and drive the individual cover, platform, clamp and positioning rod mechanisms. The command is acknowledged with COMMAND_ACK once the requested action has been accepted.
entry.param: 1: open, 2: stow, 3: aircraft power on, 4: aircraft power off, 5: replace battery, 6: stow and charge, 7: open and aircraft power on, 8: start charging, 9: stop charging, 100: cover open, 101: cover close, 102: platform extend, 103: platform retract, 104: release aircraft, 105: clamp aircraft, 106: release positioning rod, 107: centre positioning rod, 998: reset alarm, 999: emergency stop.
Maximum time to wait for the requested action to complete, 0 to use the airport default.

message.field: Maximum usage in percent of the mainloop time. Units: 0.1 % (e.g. 123 means 12.3 %). Values: [0-1000] - should always be below 1000.
Remaining free OS memory in native CPU words (on a 32-bit MCU one word equals 4 bytes). No standard MAVLink unit for CPU words, so the unit is omitted.

Heading measured by direction-finding sensor for each array element, in 0.1 deg (e.g. 1234 means 123.4 deg). -1000 = no direction-finding sensor, 1000 = direction-finding sensor present but unavailable, 0-3600 = direction-finding sensor normal.
Raw ADC voltage readings in 0.1 V (e.g. 123 means 12.3 V). No standard MAVLink unit for 0.1 V, so the unit is omitted.
Raw ADC current readings. Units: 0.01 A (e.g. 123 means 1.23 A). 0 = no current sensor on this channel.
Total capacity of the SD card in 10 MB (e.g. 123 means 1230 MB). No standard MAVLink unit for 10 MB, so the unit is omitted. 0 = no SD card inserted or capacity unknown.
Remaining free capacity of the SD card in 10 MB (e.g. 123 means 1230 MB). No standard MAVLink unit for 10 MB, so the unit is omitted. 0 = no SD card inserted or free capacity unknown.
Current flight state code (MODE_CODE). Values map one-to-one to the DJI Cloud API mode_code property. Extension field (MAVLink 2 only).

Reason for entering the current flight state (MODE_CODE_REASON). Values below 100 map one-to-one to the DJI Cloud API mode_code_reason property, values 100 and above are ACFly vendor-specific extensions. Extension field (MAVLink 2 only).

message.name: THREAD_INFO
message.description: ACFly autopilot thread status and resource usage. One message reports a single thread; the autopilot iterates the thread index so the GCS can poll every thread by counting 0..num_threads-1.
message.field: Remaining free stack space for the thread in native CPU words (on a 32-bit MCU one word equals 4 bytes). No standard MAVLink unit for CPU words, so the unit is omitted.

Total stack size allocated for the thread in native CPU words. No standard MAVLink unit for CPU words, so the unit is omitted. Stack usage ratio = (stack_size - remaining_stack) / stack_size (unit cancels out).
Thread CPU usage over the recent measurement window in centi-percent (0-10000). 10000 = 100.00%, so two decimal places are preserved without a float field.
Thread index (0-based, pairs with num_threads to iterate all threads).
Total number of threads reported by the autopilot.
Thread priority (RTOS native value; higher usually means higher priority).
